questions.subject: Food Technology
questions.prompt: Why does a teenager's body need a balanced diet with foods from every group?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.answer: Each food group gives different nutrients the body needs
questions.why: No single food group supplies everything the body needs — carbs, protein, fats, vitamins, minerals and fibre each play a different role, so a balanced diet needs variety, not just one group eaten more.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: A reaction happens in an open dish and releases a gas. Why might the measured mass seem to drop?
questions.why: In an open system, gas produced by the reaction escapes into the air, so the measured mass appears to drop even though no mass was truly lost overall.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What do we call a solid that suddenly forms when two liquids react together?
questions.why: A precipitate is the solid that forms unexpectedly when two liquids react, signalling a chemical change.
